definitions.explanation: Winning or succeeding easily without much effort. Used both for literal competitions and colloquially for any task that turns out to be easy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{楽勝|らくしょう}だった。
⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{楽勝|らくしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: We won easily against the opposing team.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧みたら{楽勝|らくしょう}だった⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Everyone said it was hard, but when I tried it, it was a piece of cake.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧ (easy, comfortable) and {勝|しょう} (victory). Originally a sports/competition term meaning an easy win, but now widely used in casual speech to mean "easy, no problem" for any task or situation.

USAGE:
Often used as a standalone exclamation ({楽勝|らくしょう}！ = "Easy!") or as an adverb ({楽勝|らくしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ = "easily"). Very common in casual male speech and among younger speakers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽勝|らくしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧: to win easily
- {楽勝|らくしょう}⟦ムード→ムード：11160_muudo⟧: an atmosphere of easy victory
- {楽勝|らくしょう}⟦ペース→ペース：11173_peesu⟧: an easy-win pace

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{圧勝|あっしょう}→圧勝：07903_asshou⟧: overwhelming victory — emphasizes the decisive margin of victory
- ⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧: with room to spare, with ease — broader term for having plenty of capacity
- ⟦{朝飯前|あさめしまえ}→朝飯前：10551_asameshimae⟧: a piece of cake (lit. "before breakfast") — an idiom meaning something very easy
